issues.description: generate-stories cannot bootstrap a fresh dataset because it requires an existing stories manifest before generation.
The advertised demo path runs extraction directly even though data/stories contains no story files in this workspace.
parse_story_block treats any preamble before the first <NEW STORY> delimiter as a story, corrupting generated datasets.
Generated stories are saved without validating count, delimiter quality, forbidden emotion words, empty text, or minimum length.
HTTP story generation has no timeout, retry handling, or HTTPS enforcement for bearer-token requests.
load_vectors trusts existing artifacts without checking model, scale, dimensions, config, or source-data freshness.
all_token_activations stacks every hidden state for every token before filtering, creating avoidable large memory spikes.
Neutral activations for all layers are materialized at once before PCA, which will not scale to larger neutral corpora.
pca_components divides by total variance without handling zero-variance input, producing NaNs on degenerate data.
emotion_vectors does not validate that every emotion has samples, so missing classes silently produce NaN vectors.
mean_activations can divide by zero for one-token or effectively empty inputs.
Runtime dependencies are only lower-bounded, leaving the ML stack and model-loading behavior unreproducible.
Ignored generated artifacts are present in the workspace, including emovec.egg-info and outputs/tiny, which obscures clean-source state.
Story dataset tests are skipped when data is absent, so the broken fresh-checkout data path is not caught.
